observations: NetEdit 1.27.1 reloaded the portable relative-path candidate and display-only review.add.xml successfully.
Connection Mode displayed all twelve continuous internal curves; no unexpected U-turn, crossed target-lane binding, or disconnected internal path was visible.

Detailed lane selection confirmed the northwest three-lane approach maps one lane each to right, through, and left; each other approach has a shared right/through lane plus a dedicated left-turn lane.
The translucent target overlay remains confined to the joined physical cell, while the four guard junctions and surrounding approach topology remain outside the edit.
